title: Great pot holders, durable and long lasting!
text: Great pot holders, durable and long lasting!. I love DII products. Usually very reasonably priced, the quality can't be beat. These pot holders are no exception. Well made, they stand up to heat easily to protect my hands from oven and bakeware. I have washed them once in my washing machine and they came out looking like they were new. I love this whole product line as the colors match flawlessly and make my kitchen look clean and fresh. These would make a great shower gift to give the new bride (or even home/apartment dweller) as a complete set for the kitchen. Can't go wrong, great price and quality!
